content.text:
**Finding submitted: MISSING (critical) — no indemnification provisions exist.**

- The outline runs Section 19 (Warranties) → Section 21 (Limitation of Liability); there is no Section 20, and searches for "indemnif", "defend" and "hold harmless" return no operative obligation anywhere in the document.
- Several clauses nonetheless assume indemnities exist: Section 9.3 cross-references "the remedies required by Section 20.5", Section 19.4 preserves remedies for "indemnified claims", Section 19.5 refers to an "indemnity", Section 21.3 makes "indemnification obligations" Excluded Claims, and Section 30.5 protects "vested indemnity rights". These are dangling references.
- Result today: Vendor owes us no IP infringement or misconduct indemnity at all — the playbook walk-away outcome.

Redline (validated ok:true): inserted a new Section 20 after § 19.5 containing (20.1) Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct/fraud; (20.2) a narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law; (20.3) standard notice/control/cooperation and settlement-consent procedure; (20.4) customary IP exclusions; and (20.5) procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, which also cures the Section 9.3 cross-reference. No super-cap was added since § 21.3 already carves indemnities out of the liability cap.
